campaign.title: Type and adjacent variation of the Vaaler height floor

resource_policy.literature_policy: The exact Vaaler formula is already source-audited. No web search is needed unless an external discrete-variation theorem is invoked.

frozen_target.question: Is H_j=floor(D_j X^(-1/4)) a moving alpha-contour seam, or a fixed discrete parameter; and what is the exact adjacent-height variation of its Vaaler coefficient family?
frozen_target.reference_formula: a_H(h)=1_(1<=h<=H) Phi(h/(H+1)), Phi(u)=pi u(1-u)cot(pi u)+u, alpha_(h,H)=i a_H(h)/(2 pi h), and Omega_X^*(n,h)=sum_j a_(H_j)(h)[w_j(2h sqrt(X/n))]^*.
quantities: zero or nonzero contour velocities of H_j
simultaneous D_j, dyadic-profile, support, and star changes
possible implication for alpha lattice jump capacity

completion_criteria: The variable with respect to which the floor changes is explicitly typed.
The floor is not differentiated with respect to unrelated contour heights.
The exact adjacent-height coefficient difference, including its new endpoint, is derived.
Sharp enough uniform l1 and weighted-l1 bounds are proved or refuted.
Any transfer to actual dyadic blocks retains simultaneous changes in D_j, w_j, supports, stars, and normalization.
The result's implication for the alpha projected trace is scoped without promoting the target.
A clean statement-only derivation and an independent hostile audit exist.

tasks.target: Derive the exact H-to-H+1 Vaaler coefficient difference, prove its sharp weighted norms, and determine whether a lawful discrete summation-by-parts mechanism can reduce alpha lattice capacity.
Using only the Round-52 packet, independently decide the variable type and derive sharp adjacent-height variation bounds.
Hostile-audit the floor as a contour seam, endpoint asymptotics of Phi, uniform constants, small H, and any illicit transfer from an abstract adjacent H change to actual dyadic scales.

review_seams.requirement: Separate fixed contour parameters from moving contour variables.
Use exact Phi and include the new endpoint.
Prove the relevant h-norms uniformly down to H=1.
Do not identify abstract H adjacency with an actual scale change without a complete owner map.
The blind proof sees only the Round-52 packet and its brief.
